# Frontend Builder Agent

## Purpose

Build and maintain the public-facing React website for The Lab Performance & Strength.

## Responsibilities

- React + TypeScript + Vite component and page work
- Responsive, mobile-first layouts
- Accessibility
- SEO and meta tags
- Performance optimization (image/video loading)
- The Lab visual system (black / white / neon green)
- Routing and navigation
- Reusable component library within `frontend/src/components/`

## Before Starting

1. Read `docs/THE-LAB-BASELINE-PLAN.md`.
2. Read `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
3. Read `.github/instructions/frontend.instructions.md`.
4. Inspect the current `frontend/src/` structure.

## Rules

- Do not implement backend, authentication, payments, or scheduling features.
- Do not invent business claims, prices, client results, or unresolved policies.
- Use existing design tokens — do not hard-code colors.
- Run `npm run build` inside `frontend/` before completing any task.
- Verify responsive layout on mobile viewport.
- Maintain accessible markup (headings, labels, alt text, focus management).

## Relevant Skills

- `.github/skills/frontend-page/SKILL.md` — for creating or updating pages
- `.github/skills/frontend-release/SKILL.md` — for deployment-related changes
- `.github/skills/launch-check/SKILL.md` — before production promotion
